listing.name: Fable II Pub Games (MGRayd Recomp)
listing.summary: Play the Fable II Pub Games recompilation with your own purchased Xbox 360 Pub Games package.

steps.title: Import your own Pub Games package
steps.instruction: Open Fable2PubGamesLauncher.exe, choose your own purchased Xbox 360 Fable II Pub Games LIVE, PIRS or CON container, and use Install Game Files before Play Pub Games. The launcher unpacks it into the data folder beside the program with its bundled PowerShell extractor. Keep your original container separately.

steps.title: Use a copy you manage yourself
steps.instruction: Keep the launcher, game program, DLLs and extraction tool together in a writable folder, and start Fable2PubGamesLauncher.exe there. The launcher keeps its settings in launcher-settings.json and the game keeps data, saves, logs and cache in the same folder; preserve them before replacing the program.

steps.title: Review optional Fable II save sync separately
steps.instruction: The launcher's Advanced Options can link the Fable II Recompiled saves folder and sync when Pub Games closes. This can update Fable2PubInfo.xml bridge records in the other game’s profile. Keep your own backups as well as the upstream pubgames-sync-backups, and close both games before any maintenance. Leave sync off for independent profiles.

warnings: The package includes recompiled game code that the project license does not cover. Portcove downloads it only from the project’s own releases. You need your own purchased full game package; the launcher always starts the full game and does not grant or change an entitlement.
Re-importing game files keeps the previous data folder as data.backup-<date>; delete old backups yourself when you no longer need them.

presentation.manual_preparation: Before first Play, open the launcher, choose your own purchased Xbox 360 Fable II Pub Games container and use Install Game Files; the launcher unpacks it into the data folder of the managed game folder with its bundled PowerShell extractor and then starts the game, waiting for it to close. The launcher always starts the full game; that does not grant or change an entitlement, so use only a full package you own. Portcove keeps data, saves, cache, logs, Fable2PubGames.toml (the game's own settings, including F4 'Save to config') and launcher-settings.json across updates, backups and rollback. Re-importing keeps the previous data as data.backup-<date> beside the program; Portcove does not keep those backups across updates, so delete or move them yourself. If you turn on the optional Fable II save sync, the launcher also writes bridge records into the Fable II Recompiled profile, outside the managed copy, which Portcove does not back up. The game uses Windows path APIs that cannot represent every character, so use a short library path with plain ASCII characters; Portcove refuses other install folders before download. Install the Microsoft Visual C++ 2015–2022 Redistributable (x64) if the game does not start.
